description: Upload a FIT, TCX or GPX file (base64, at most 15 MB decoded) and get its activityId and expiresAt. Files are held in memory only and expire (30 minutes after last use, 2 hours at most); originals are never changed. Base64 costs a lot of context: an agent with a shell should upload with curl to POST https://thesplit.fit/api/v1/activities (multipart field file) and use the returned activityId here. Call delete_activity for every activity you are done with.

contentBase64.description: The whole file, standard base64 with padding (length a multiple of 4). At most 15 MB decoded.

filename.description: The file's name, ending .fit, .tcx or .gpx (it selects the parser).

name: upload_activity
